risks.risk: Oven/compartment may not heat properly (not shown by burner flames).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of the oven preheating and reaching temperature with the oven door closed (or a thermometer reading).
risks.if_unproven: Price as burners working but oven not confirmed (worst case: oven not working).

risks.risk: Electric coil burners may be weak/defective even if present.
risks.proof: Ask for a video showing each electric coil turning on and glowing red at low and high settings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as electric coils not working (worst case: only gas burners confirmed).

risks.risk: Ignition/knob control issues (some burners may light inconsistently).
risks.proof: Ask for a clip where each gas burner is turned on from off one-by-one showing consistent ignition.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed for consistent ignition (worst case: one burner unreliable).

risks.risk: Gas safety issues: leaks, damaged hoses/valves, or poor burner alignment.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the gas inlet/valve area and a soapy-water leak test clip at connections.
risks.if_unproven: Price with safety risk assumed until tested (worst case: needs servicing).

risks.risk: Condition/age not verifiable; hidden rust or worn burner caps/grates.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of burner caps, grates, and oven interior (top/bottom).
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible wear (worst case: parts wear).

proof_requests: Video: oven turned on and preheating (door closed) with thermometer/clear heat-up time.
Video: each electric coil burner working (turn on from off; show glow/red heat at low and high).
Video: each gas burner ignition from off one-by-one to confirm consistent lighting.
Close-up photos of gas inlet/valve area and burner caps/grates; plus a soapy-water leak test clip at connections.
Photos of the receipt/warranty card and a readable rating/serial label (brand/model).
response.reason: The seller’s reply is only a claim; without new photos/videos, the oven and electric coils (and gas safety) remain unproven. A reliable worst-case price still can’t be set confidently.
